text:
sam: Quick sync: Zenfolio POC (mid-market finance) has SSO + SCIM + RBAC asks. They need IdP-initiated SSO, encrypted assertions, group->role mappings, and a SCIM deprovision policy. Also security questionnaire inbound — pushing for answers by EOW. Who can drive?

maria: I can own SAML metadata + SCIM endpoints. They specifically asked for attribute mapping: groups -> roles. Is that supported on hosted or only Dedicated? @jenna any notes on rate limits?

jenna: Hosted supports SAML attribute mapping for common IdPs; group->role mapping is supported via attribute-to-role rules in Console. For very large orgs (>10k groups) or heavy SCIM delta, recommend Dedicated or SCIM add-on. Pricing-wise, SCIM heavy syncs may incur extra charge. I'll pull a ballpark.

ops-bot: INF ticket created: INF-4567 — Dedicated sizing + scim-ratequote.

alex_security: Security triage: we'll need SOC2 summary, encryption at rest details, and SCIM de-provision policy. By default Hosted uses soft-delete 30 days; can discuss shorter windows. Also confirm if they require BYOK — Hosted supports BYOK on Dedicated and Private.

maria: For RBAC — Console supports role templates + admin delegation. For dynamic mapping we can sync groups via SCIM and map via a rule: `groupName -> roleId`. Quick sample:
```
scim.filter=Group.displayName =~ /^zen_/
role_mapping: { "zen_admins": "admin_role_id" }
```
If they can't filter on source side, we can add a prefix filter on our sync to reduce objects.

sam: Can someone give a pricing ballpark for ~50k users + 2k SCIM changes/week? Also timeline: they want the security questionnaire back EOW.

jenna: I'll have a draft quote by EOD tomorrow with Hosted vs Dedicated delta. I'll include scim-rate assumptions.

alex_security: I'll take the security questionnaire. Need POC contact. Please add client contact email in the ticket.

sam: Action items: @jenna draft quote, @maria prepare SAML/SCIM example and attr map, @alex_security draft security answers, ops-bot INF-4567 for sizing. I'll loop in account exec. :thumbsup:
